blog.title: Small Firms, Big Models: What This Week's AI Releases Mean for Cross-Border SMEs
blog.content:
# Small Firms, Big Models

This week brought three model releases and one pricing change that matter more to a ten-person firm in Geneva than any benchmark chart.

## The pricing shift

Cheaper long-context calls mean a small team can now summarise a full year of client email for less than the cost of a lunch. The catch is governance: **who reviews the output** before it reaches a client?

## What we recommend

- Start with one workflow, not ten.
- Measure time saved per week, not tokens used.
- Keep a human in the loop for anything client-facing.

Read the [full release notes](https://example.com/notes) for details.

Key takeaways: start with one workflow, measure hours saved, and keep a human reviewing client-facing output.
